name: digital-monorepo-qa
description: Playwright + TypeScript end-to-end test automation suite for Premier Inn digital

scripts.test: npx playwright test; bash ./scripts/allure-report.sh --no-open; npx tsx ./scripts/notify-teams.ts; npx allure open ./reports/${APP:-pi}/allure-report
scripts.test:local: EXECUTION_ENV=local npx playwright test; bash ./scripts/allure-report.sh --no-open; npx tsx ./scripts/notify-teams.ts; npx allure open ./reports/${APP:-pi}/allure-report
scripts.test:smoke: GREP=@smoke npx playwright test; bash ./scripts/allure-report.sh --no-open; npx tsx ./scripts/notify-teams.ts; npx allure open ./reports/${APP:-pi}/allure-report
scripts.test:regression: GREP=@regression npx playwright test; bash ./scripts/allure-report.sh --no-open; npx tsx ./scripts/notify-teams.ts; npx allure open ./reports/${APP:-pi}/allure-report
scripts.test:pi:uat: APP=pi ENV=uat npx playwright test; bash ./scripts/allure-report.sh
scripts.test:pi:dit: APP=pi ENV=dit npx playwright test; bash ./scripts/allure-report.sh
scripts.test:pib:uat: APP=pib ENV=uat npx playwright test; bash ./scripts/allure-report.sh
scripts.test:pib:dit: APP=pib ENV=dit npx playwright test; bash ./scripts/allure-report.sh
scripts.test:ccui:uat: APP=ccui ENV=uat npx playwright test; bash ./scripts/allure-report.sh
scripts.test:ccui:dit: APP=ccui ENV=dit npx playwright test; bash ./scripts/allure-report.sh
